title: PublicKeyCertificateSet - Metadata API
description: Represents a set of public certificate keys. On this entity we store a public certificates or JSON web keys.

description.description: A description of the public key certificate set.

jwksEndPoint.description: The URL of the HTTPS Server that returns the JWKS.

jwtIssuer.description: The user, organization, or service that issued the JSON web token. This value is case-sensitive.

masterLabel.description: The label for the public key certificate set.

publicKeyCertificateSetKeys.description: A set of public certificate keys associated with the public key certificate set.

type.description: Determines how the server's public key set is retrieved. The keys are represented in JWK format. Values are: JWKS- Used to specify a certificate via the child Type PublicKeyCertificateSetKey. JWKS_URL- Used to specify a certificate via the jwksEndPoint field on this Type.

publicKeyCertificate.description: The PublicKeyCertificate we want to reference.

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: The following is an example of a PublicKeyCertificateSet component.
declarative_metadata_sample_definition.code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<PublicKeyCertificateSet xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <masterLabel>pcks1</masterLabel>
    <description>This is my description for a PublicKeyCertificateSet</description>
    <type>JWKS</type>
    <jwtIssuer>example.com</jwtIssuer>
    <publicKeyCertificateSetKeys>
            <publicKeyCertificate>pck1</publicKeyCertificate>
    </publicKeyCertificateSetKeys>
</PublicKeyCertificateSet>
